title: Christmas Joy
excerpt: Joy to the world, the Lord is come! Let earth receive her King; Let every heart prepare Him room, And Heaven and nature sing! Thoughts from philosophers and theologians … A merry and meaningful Christmas to all … You are loved!
body:
Joy to the world, the Lord is come!

Let earth receive her King;

Let every heart prepare Him room,

And Heaven and nature sing!

Thoughts from philosophers and theologians …

A merry and meaningful Christmas to all …

You are loved!
